label: Factory
depicts: Factory block with one tall stack above a zigzag roof and two windows
use_when: Use when the interface wants a boxy factory building with a zigzag roof and window dots.
avoid_when: Do not use for the cooling tower factory when the main shapes should be two tall towers.

label: Fan
depicts: Five petal fan swirl with curved blades around a centered hub
use_when: Use when the interface wants a fan drawn as five curved swirl blades around the center.
avoid_when: Do not use for the four loop fan when the blades should look like overlapping circles.

label: Fan
depicts: Four loop fan shape with round blade circles overlapping around a centered hub
use_when: Use when the interface wants a fan built from four round loop blades instead of swirl petals.
avoid_when: Do not use for the five petal swirl fan when the blades should curl more sharply.

label: Filter
depicts: Funnel form with a wide top narrow neck and pointed lower tip
use_when: Use when the interface wants a classic funnel filter tapering to a pointed lower tip.
avoid_when: Do not use for the stacked filter bars when the icon should be made from horizontal lines.

label: Filter
depicts: Three horizontal filter bars descending in length from top to bottom
use_when: Use when the interface wants a filter mark drawn as three descending horizontal bars.
avoid_when: Do not use for the funnel shaped filters when the icon should not taper into a neck.
